name: CR-P2

dimensions.note: Width is the long side of the two-lobed top view; the datasheet gives a 16.8 mm reference spacing between the cell centers.

geometry.note: Two cylindrical cells side by side in one keyed wrap, each lobe about 16.8 mm apart center to center. Both terminals sit on one end face as two round contacts, one at the center of each lobe, marked + and -, per the datasheet drawing.

interchange.note: The 2CR5 is a similar 6 V pack with a different footprint and contact layout, and the keyed shapes do not fit each other.

safety: Lithium photo batteries are single-use and are not designed to be recharged; charging can cause venting, fire or rupture.
Do not short-circuit, crush, heat or disassemble. The battery contains a positive temperature coefficient (PTC) device to limit short-circuit current, but it does not make the battery safe to abuse.
Replace all batteries in a device at the same time and do not mix them with used batteries or other types.
notes: The wrap is keyed so it fits a compartment in one orientation only. Wikipedia lists the 223A and CR17-33 names.
